days.title: 高平市 – 北坡
days.morning: Arrive in Cao Bang, breakfast on rice rolls with broth.
days.afternoon: Pac Bo historic site, Lenin stream and Coc Bo cave.
days.evening: Enjoy seven-flavour roast duck and stay in the city.

days.title: 板约瀑布
days.morning: Cross Ma Phuc pass to Ban Gioc and take a bamboo raft to the falls.
days.afternoon: Truc Lam Buddhist pagoda and Nguom Ngao cave.
days.evening: Stay at a homestay in Trung Khanh.

days.title: 汤亨湖 – 考谷茶
days.morning: See Thang Hen lake and the "14-tier" Khau Coc Cha pass.
days.afternoon: Phuc Sen blacksmith village and Phja Thap incense village.
days.evening: Buy Trung Khanh chestnuts and try sour phở.

days.title: 神眼山 – 保乐
days.morning: The Eye of God (pierced mountain) in Quang Uyen.
days.afternoon: Cross Ma Phuc pass to Bao Lac and the winding Gam river.
days.evening: Stay in Bao Lac and try bánh áp chao pastries.

days.title: 巴贝湖
days.morning: Transfer to Bac Kan and boat across Ba Be lake.
days.afternoon: Puong cave, Fairy pond and Widow island.
days.evening: Homestay in Pac Ngoi village with grilled lake fish.
